description: This PHP class 'FormatWithPurgeTime' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to get the current date and time formatted for use in a purge strategy. It uses a trait for DateTime helper functions and is part of the 'OrangeHRM' HR management system, specifically within the maintenance purge strategy's formatting namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTime
classes.description: Implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide the current date and time for purge operations.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the current date and time by utilizing the DateTimeHelperTrait.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime as per system time, serving as the formatted value for purge logic.
